channel.description: Latest articles from Real Response Media (realresponsemedia.co.uk)

item.title: Eight of the best Black Friday cruise deals to snap up now
item.description: During Black Friday and Cyber Monday, the sheer volume of offers can be overwhelming. Here are eight cruise deals that genuinely deserve your attention.

item.title: Glitz and celebration as the 2025 Wave Awards light up London
item.description: The movers and shakers of the UK cruise sector gathered at The Dorchester last night (26 November) for the 2025 Wave Awards this week. The event delivered an evening of sparkle, applause and standout achievements.

item.title: Line marks 60 years since first tourist expedition to Antarctica
item.description: National Geographic-Lindblad Expeditions is marking 60 years since Lars-Eric Lindblad’s pioneering voyage to Antarctica with a new anniversary offer.

item.title: Princess Cruises launches Wave sale offering up to £800 off
item.description: Here’s everything you need to know about this premium cruise line’s V.I.P. sale, including how to unlock the highest savings.

item.title: Oceania Cruises reveals a new ship in a class of its own
item.description: Here’s a sneak peek at the luxury cruise line’s latest addition. Meet Oceania Sonata and find out why it’s set to herald a new era of luxury at sea.

item.title: Marella Cruises launches sale with savings of up to £300 per booking
item.description: Dreaming of your next adventure? It’s closer than you think. Here’s how to claim your discount on a Marella cruise, plus three reasons to book.

item.title: Top 10 cruise trends for 2026 according to experts
item.description: We unpack the biggest cruise trends for the coming year and share practical tips on how to experience them firsthand.

item.title: What the situation in Venezuela means for Caribbean cruises
item.description: Several thousand passengers were affected by airspace restrictions over the weekend (3-4 January). While the situation has since stabilised, cruisers with upcoming Caribbean bookings should monitor how circumstances evolve.

item.title: Oceania Cruises is becoming an adults-only line
item.description: The luxury line has announced it is transitioning to a kids-free cruise experience, with all new bookings restricted to guests aged 18 and over.

item.title: World of Cruising TV season 4 has landed
item.description: World of Cruising TV is back on the small screen with fresh faces, new ships and real-life cruise stories
